verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a flow built for spending insights: Link CLI lets the customer's agent read permissioned transactions, balances and account data and use it to "answer questions about spending, balances, and trends" (e.g. "What did I spend on dining this month?"). However, the insights are generated by the user's own external agent, and the "personalized recommendations" happen in third-party chat agents rather than inside Stripe's product. missing for 10: native in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced by Stripe itself (e.g. Dashboard insights on agentic sales or catalog data), seller-side analytics suggestions, any hands-on or independent corroboration of insight quality.
